vulnerable_code:
class InvitationsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    # Permits workspace_id directly from user input
    @invitation = Invitation.new(invitation_params)
    @invitation.sender = current_user

    if @invitation.save
      render json: @invitation, status: :created
    else
      render json: @invitation.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def invitation_params
    params.require(:invitation).permit(:recipient_email, :role, :workspace_id)
  end
end
diagnosis: Permitting workspace_id in strong parameters allows an authenticated user to dispatch workspace invitations for any workspace on the platform. An attacker can add colluding accounts with admin privileges into foreign corporate workspaces.

corrected_code:
class InvitationsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    workspace = current_user.administered_workspaces.find(params[:workspace_id])
    @invitation = workspace.invitations.build(invitation_params)
    @invitation.sender = current_user

    if @invitation.save
      render json: @invitation, status: :created
    else
      render json: @invitation.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def invitation_params
    params.require(:invitation).permit(:recipient_email, :role)
  end
end
